global.criterion: Compact sculpted 3D cartoon educational miniature on warm off-white with plausible material textures and clean margins, not photoreal full-field photography or toy-faced characters.
No rendered words, numerals, arrows, pseudo-writing, labels, source school/Spark identity, brand-like emblems, logos or watermarks.
No people, hands, characters, active sampling, fertilizer, chemical treatment, diagnosis or actual soil transfer.

s104-video-example-yellow-patch.criterion: Irregular weak yellow patch lies inside a mostly greener larger field model, with a separate healthier comparison area and two blank unused holders; no diagnosis/remedy.
Low oblique outdoor field-case view is not the earlier rectangular tray split into equal crop strips or the accepted overhead reading still.

s104-video-example-bucket-choice.criterion: Two separate empty buckets show clean smooth plastic versus visibly worn galvanized zinc-coated inner rim; no cross-contamination actually occurs.
Shows an unsuitable worn bucket for this sampling task without claiming every metal tool is forbidden.
Tight lower paired-bucket close-up, no probe/fertilizer, differs from broad still and previous three-contact-path explanation image.

s104-video-example-between-fields.criterion: A real hollow sampling probe's inner groove visibly retains a tiny old-field soil trace while a separate clean next-field station remains untouched across a gap; no transfer or universal cleaning recipe.
Extreme close focus on inner groove differs from wide preparation route, accepted contamination still and earlier four-tool scene.
